[[Dwayna's Grace]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[Scythe]] dropped by [[Acolyte of Dwayna]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Dejarin Estate]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]]: +15% (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:Enchantments last 20% longer
:Two-handed

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Suntouched Scythe]] [[dye]]d white.
